description: A secondary button that opens a Menu of items (DESIGN.md, Menu): a press, Enter or Space opens it on its first item, the up arrow on its last; icon is optional, before label.

constructors.description: A menu button labelled label, opening items.

params.name: icon
params.description: Before the label; never read itself.

params.name: items
params.description: The menu's items, opened in this order.

params.name: focusNode
params.description: The node to track the button's focus with, when the caller manages one.

params.name: autofocus
params.description: Focuses it as soon as it is built.
